input.response:
Yes, I'm familiar with the Stoic philosophy and its writings. Stoicism is an ancient Greek philosophy that was founded by Zeno of Citium in Athens in the early 3rd century BC. It is a philosophy of personal ethics informed by its system of logic and its views on the natural world.

The Stoics are especially known for teaching that "virtue is the only good" for human beings, and that external things - such as health, wealth, and pleasure - are not good or bad in themselves, but have value only as "material for virtue to act upon". Alongside Aristotelian ethics, the Stoic tradition forms one of the major founding approaches to Western virtue ethics.

Several Stoic philosophers wrote letters that have survived to the present day and are considered important texts in the Stoic tradition. Some of the most well-known Stoic letters include:

* The Meditations of Marcus Aurelius: This is a series of personal writings by the Roman Emperor Marcus Aurelius, who ruled from 161 to 180 AD. The Meditations are a philosophical diary in which Marcus reflects on the nature of the universe, the importance of living in accordance with reason and virtue, and the need to accept the things that are outside of one's control.
* The Letters of Seneca: Seneca was a Roman Stoic philosopher, statesman, and dramatist who lived in the 1st century AD. His letters are addressed to various friends and acquaintances and cover a wide range of topics, including ethics, politics, and literature.
* The Discourses and Selected Writings of Epictetus: Epictetus was a Greek Stoic philosopher who lived in the 1st and 2nd centuries AD. His Discourses are a series of lectures that he gave to his students, and his Selected Writings include various letters and other short pieces. Epictetus' teachings focus on the idea that humans have no control over external events, but can choose how they respond to those events.

These and other Stoic writings continue to be studied and admired for their wisdom and insight into the human condition.

input.text:
(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where are Sayori and MC?”

Yuri: “I’m not sure. I haven’t seen them since this morning.”

Natsuki: “They’re probably off somewhere being all lovey-dovey.”

Monika: “Well, I hope they’re not skipping club activities. We have a lot planned for today.”

Yuri: “Maybe we should go look for them? Just to make sure they’re okay.”

Sayori: (bursts into the clubroom, panting) “Sorry, sorry! We got caught up in something, but we’re here now!”

Monika: “Oh, there you are! I was beginning to worry. Is everything alright?”

MC: (smiling) “Yeah, sorry for being late. Sayori wanted to show me something on our way to school.”

Sayori: (catching her breath) “It was a beautiful sunrise! I just had to share it with MC.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Seriously? You two are so mushy.”

Yuri: (giggles) “It’s sweet. Don’t be jealous, Natsuki.”

Monika: smiling softly “Well, I’m glad you both made it. We were just starting to wonder where you went off to.”

MC: “We promise we won’t skip club activities again. We just got carried away this time. But we also have some good news to share with all of you!”

Natsuki: (raises an eyebrow) “Good news? What is it?”

Sayori: (grinning) “MC and I are getting married!”

Natsuki: (jaw drops) “Wait, really? You two are getting married?”

Yuri: (covers her mouth in surprise) “That’s…wow, congratulations!”

Monika: (smiling brightly) “Oh my goodness, that’s amazing news! Congratulations, you two!”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone! We’re really excited.”

Sayori: (hugging MC) “I can’t believe it! I’m going to marry my best friend!”

Natsuki: (sniffles) “I’m not crying, okay? Just…happy for you both.”

Yuri: (wipes a tear from her eye) “It’s such a beautiful thing, finding love like that.”

Monika: (still smiling) “We’ll have to plan your wedding celebration, of course. I’m sure the club would love to help.”

MC: “That would be wonderful. We couldn’t think of a better support system than our Literature Club family.”

Sayori: (grinning) “And we’ll have cupcakes at the reception, right Natsuki?”

Natsuki: (blushes) “Well, I guess since it’s a special occasion, I could make an exception.”

Yuri: (giggles) “I can already imagine the decorations and ambiance. It will be a fairytale wedding.”

Monika: (clasps her hands together) “I’m so happy for you both. This calls for a celebration!”

MC: (holds Sayori’s hand) “Thank you, everyone. We feel incredibly lucky to have such amazing friends.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “Well, get ready for a lifetime of mushy couple stuff. We’ll be here to tease you through it all.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also to support and celebrate your love. Congratulations, Sayori and MC!”

Monika: (beaming) “Let’s make this the best wedding ever. Sayori and MC, here’s to a lifetime of happiness together!”

(A few months later, at MC and Sayori’s wedding…)

(The entire Literature Club is gathered in a beautifully decorated venue. Sayori is in a stunning white wedding dress, glowing with happiness, while MC looks dashing in his tailored suit. The room is filled with love and excitement. The music starts to play as the ceremony begins.)

Monika: (serving as the officiant) “Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to witness the union of Sayori and MC in holy matrimony. Love is a journey that brings two souls together, and today, we celebrate the start of a new chapter for this remarkable couple…”

(Yuri, Natsuki, and Monika all read poems they’ve written especially for the occasion, expressing their heartfelt support and well wishes for the newlyweds.)

Yuri: “May your love for one another be strong and unyielding, like the unending verses of a beautiful poem.”

Natsuki: “And may the joy you find in each other’s embrace be as delicious and sweet as the finest cupcakes you both have shared.”

Monika: “In this club, we have shared countless moments, gathered here by our mutual love for literature. Today, we extend that love to celebrate the union of two passionate souls.”

(The couple exchange heartfelt vows, promising to support each other through thick and thin, to always cherish their love, and to create a future filled with happiness and laughter.)

MC: “Sayori, you have brought light into my life since the day we met. You’ve shown me what it means to be loved unconditionally and to find joy in the simplest of things. I promise to always be your rock, your shoulder to lean on, and your partner in all of life’s adventures.”

Sayori: “MC, you’ve been my sunshine through the darkest of times. You’ve shown me a love that makes me believe in miracles and fills my heart with warmth. I promise to stand by your side, to always be your cheerleader, and to love you fiercely through every chapter of our lives.”

(Monika officiates the exchange of rings, symbolizing the eternal bond between the couple.)

Monika: “By the powers vested in me, I now pronounce you husband and wife. You may seal this union with a kiss.”

(MC and Sayori share a passionate and loving kiss, sealing their vows and sealing their love for eternity. The room erupts in applause and cheers.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “Oh gosh, I can’t handle all this lovey-dovey stuff!”

Yuri: (smiling) “It truly feels like a dream come true. I’m so happy for them.”

(Years later, the birth of MC Junior…)

(Months after their magical wedding, MC and Sayori are thrilled to announce that they are expecting their first child. The whole Literature Club gathers in anticipation and excitement.)

Monika: “Wow, congratulations, you two! This is such exciting news!”

Natsuki: “A baby?! Oh my gosh, this is so cute. I can’t wait to be an auntie!”

Yuri: “This is truly a blessing. A little one to continue your beautiful love story.”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone. We couldn’t be happier. It’s a dream come true.”

Sayori: (holding her baby bump with affection) “We’re going to be parents! I can’t believe it!”

Monika: “We’ll have to plan a baby shower and help you with anything you need. The Literature Club is here for you every step of the way.”

Natsuki: “Just make sure to bring some cupcakes to the baby shower, Sayori. You can’t forget that!”

Yuri: “I can already imagine the adorable baby clothes and nursery decorations. It’s going to be such a joyous celebration.”

MC: “We feel so lucky to have such wonderful friends who are just as excited as we are. Thank you for your love and support.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “And we promise to raise this little one surrounded by the love and warmth the Literature Club has given us.”

Natsuki: “Well, get ready for more lovey-dovey and mushy stuff, guys! Babies have a way of bringing out the sweetness.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also sleepless nights, diapers, and a whole lot of responsibilities. But it will all be worth it.”

Monika: (smiling) “Let’s make this baby shower a celebration to remember. MC and Sayori, here’s to the beginning of a new journey!”

(Several months later, at MC and Sayori’s baby shower…)

(The Literature Club has transformed the clubroom into a magical baby wonderland. The walls are adorned with delicate paper decorations, and a large table filled with gifts and sweet treats takes center stage. The room is buzzing with laughter and excitement.)

Monika: “Congratulations, Sayori and MC! This baby shower is a celebration of the love and joy you’ve brought into our lives.”

Natsuki: (holding up a cupcake) “And to celebrate the little cupcake that’s on their way!”

Yuri: (reading a heartfelt poem) “May this precious child fill your lives with endless love, laughter, and joy.”

MC: “We’re overwhelmed by the love and support we’ve received from the Literature Club. Thank you for being a part of this special journey.”

Sayori: “We can’t wait to welcome this little one into a world filled with so much love. They’ll have the best aunties and uncles in all of literature!”

(The room erupts in laughter and cheers as the Literature Club showers the couple with gifts and well wishes.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “I’m so excited to meet this little bundle of joy. They’re going to be the luckiest baby ever.”

Yuri: (holding a handmade baby blanket) “This blanket represents all the warmth and love we’ve poured into it. May it keep your little one cozy and safe.”

Monika: “Alright, now that that’s out of the way, time to reveal the gender!”

input.task: Write me a action/spy movie about Zohanele "Zohan" Dvir, a former retired israeli counterterrorist whos now a barber but then was kidnapped and went unconscious by mafia and was taking to new mexico where the show breaking bad comes in so zohan needs to help from sikke van der veer aka fietsopa

criteria.question: 故事是否利用Zohan作为前以色列反恐特工和理发师的独特技能/背景来推动剧情发展或解决危机，而非仅将其作为普通角色？
《绝命毒师》的故事背景（如新墨西哥州的特定环境、人物或风格）是否被有机地整合进Zohan被绑架及救援的核心情节中，而不仅仅是作为背景板提及？
Sikke van der Veer (fietsopa) 是否在故事中扮演了关键的协助者角色，并具体展示了其如何帮助Zohan摆脱黑手党控制？
故事是否完整呈现了从Zohan被绑架昏迷到最终获救的行动/间谍电影式情节闭环？

input.response:
Title: "The Barber of Breaking Bad"

In the bustling streets of New York City, Zohanele "Zohan" Dvir (played by Adam Sandler) has settled into a peaceful life as a barber, leaving his past as a former Israeli counterterrorist behind. However, his tranquil existence is shattered when he's kidnapped by a ruthless mafia group seeking to exploit his unique skills for their own nefarious purposes. 

Zohan wakes up in a desolate warehouse in New Mexico, disoriented and confused. He soon discovers that the mafia, led by the cunning and vicious Don Salvatore (played by Harvey Keitel), plans to use him to eliminate their competition in the local drug trade. Unbeknownst to them, Zohan has no intention of returning to his old ways. 

Meanwhile, in the small town of Albuquerque, Sikke van der Veer (played by Jeroen van Koningsbrugge), a retired Dutch special forces operative known as "Fietsopa" (Grandpa Bike) due to his love for cycling, runs a small bike shop. Sikke's quiet life is interrupted when he receives a cryptic message from an old friend, urging him to help Zohan. 

Sikke infiltrates the mafia's compound and rescues Zohan, who is grateful but determined to bring down the criminal organization without resorting to violence. Together, they devise a plan to sabotage the mafia's operations from within, using Zohan's charisma and Sikke's tactical expertise. 

Posing as a new recruit, Zohan infiltrates the mafia's ranks and begins to subtly disrupt their activities. He befriends the local drug lord, Tuco Salamanca (played by Raymond Cruz), and uses his influence to create chaos within the organization. Meanwhile, Sikke provides support from the shadows, using his military background to outmaneuver the mafia at every turn. 

As tensions rise, Zohan and Sikke uncover a sinister plot involving the production of a new, highly addictive drug. They realize that the mafia's ambitions extend far beyond New Mexico, threatening the safety of countless innocent lives. 

In a thrilling climax, Zohan and Sikke lead a daring assault on the mafia's secret lab, facing off against Don Salvatore and his henchmen. Using their combined skills and quick thinking, they manage to dismantle the criminal empire and save the day. 

In the aftermath, Zohan returns to his barber shop in New York, while Sikke continues to run his bike shop in Albuquerque. However, they both know that their paths will cross again, as the world always needs heroes like them to stand against the forces of evil.

Title: Zohan's New Cut: A Hair-Raising Tale

Opening Scene:
Tel Aviv, Israel

The camera pans over a bustling city, focusing on a popular barbershop, "Zohan's Scissors." Inside, Zohan Dvir (Adam Sandler), a former Israeli counterterrorist agent, now a renowned barber, is giving a haircut with his signature flair. His life is peaceful, filled with laughter and the hum of scissors.

Suddenly, the shop is raided by a ruthless mafia group. Zohan fights back valiantly but is overpowered and knocked unconscious.

Act 1:

New Mexico, USA

Zohan wakes up in a deserted warehouse in New Mexico, disoriented and confused. He soon realizes he's been kidnapped and taken to the United States.

Meanwhile, in Albuquerque, Sikke van der Veer (Peter Stormare), aka Fietsopa, a former Dutch spy and now a key player in the local drug trade, is dealing with his own problems. His operation is under threat from a rival cartel, and he needs a wildcard to even the odds.

Act 2:

Zohan, using his resourcefulness and combat skills, manages to escape the warehouse. He finds himself in the harsh New Mexico desert, alone and far from home.

In Albuquerque, Sikke learns about Zohan's unique skills from a captured informant. Seeing an opportunity, he offers Zohan a deal: help him take down his rivals, and he'll help Zohan return to Israel.

Act 3:

Zohan, with Sikke's help, infiltrates the rival cartel. He uses his barber skills to gain the trust of the cartel's leader, all while planning their downfall.

Meanwhile, Sikke's operation is under attack. Zohan, using his counterterrorist training, helps Sikke's team defend their territory.

Act 4:

The final showdown takes place in a deserted warehouse, where Zohan confronts the cartel leader. Using his barber shears as a weapon, Zohan fights off the cartel's henchmen.

Sikke, realizing that Zohan is more than just a hired gun, betrays the cartel and helps Zohan. Together, they defeat the cartel and restore peace to Albuquerque.

Closing Scene:

Zohan, with Sikke's help, returns to Israel. He reopens his barbershop, now with a new appreciation for peace and the simple life. Sikke, having found a new friend and purpose, decides to leave the drug trade behind.

As Zohan cuts a customer's hair, the camera pans out, showing the peaceful city of Tel Aviv, a testament to Zohan's impact. The film ends with Zohan's signature line, "You look good!"

End of Movie.

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where are Sayori and MC?”

Yuri: “I’m not sure. I haven’t seen them since this morning.”

Natsuki: “They’re probably off somewhere being all lovey-dovey.”

Monika: “Well, I hope they’re not skipping club activities. We have a lot planned for today.”

Yuri: “Maybe we should go look for them? Just to make sure they’re okay.”

Sayori: (bursts into the clubroom, panting) “Sorry, sorry! We got caught up in something, but we’re here now!”

Monika: “Oh, there you are! I was beginning to worry. Is everything alright?”

MC: (smiling) “Yeah, sorry for being late. Sayori wanted to show me something on our way to school.”

Sayori: (catching her breath) “It was a beautiful sunrise! I just had to share it with MC.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Seriously? You two are so mushy.”

Yuri: (giggles) “It’s sweet. Don’t be jealous, Natsuki.”

Monika: smiling softly “Well, I’m glad you both made it. We were just starting to wonder where you went off to.”

MC: “We promise we won’t skip club activities again. We just got carried away this time. But we also have some good news to share with all of you!”

Natsuki: (raises an eyebrow) “Good news? What is it?”

Sayori: (grinning) “MC and I are getting married!”

Natsuki: (jaw drops) “Wait, really? You two are getting married?”

Yuri: (covers her mouth in surprise) “That’s…wow, congratulations!”

Monika: (smiling brightly) “Oh my goodness, that’s amazing news! Congratulations, you two!”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone! We’re really excited.”

Sayori: (hugging MC) “I can’t believe it! I’m going to marry my best friend!”

Natsuki: (sniffles) “I’m not crying, okay? Just…happy for you both.”

Yuri: (wipes a tear from her eye) “It’s such a beautiful thing, finding love like that.”

Monika: (still smiling) “We’ll have to plan your wedding celebration, of course. I’m sure the club would love to help.”

MC: “That would be wonderful. We couldn’t think of a better support system than our Literature Club family.”

Sayori: (grinning) “And we’ll have cupcakes at the reception, right Natsuki?”

Natsuki: (blushes) “Well, I guess since it’s a special occasion, I could make an exception.”

Yuri: (giggles) “I can already imagine the decorations and ambiance. It will be a fairytale wedding.”

Monika: (clasps her hands together) “I’m so happy for you both. This calls for a celebration!”

MC: (holds Sayori’s hand) “Thank you, everyone. We feel incredibly lucky to have such amazing friends.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “Well, get ready for a lifetime of mushy couple stuff. We’ll be here to tease you through it all.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also to support and celebrate your love. Congratulations, Sayori and MC!”

Monika: (beaming) “Let’s make this the best wedding ever. Sayori and MC, here’s to a lifetime of happiness together!”

(A few months later, at MC and Sayori’s wedding…)

(The entire Literature Club is gathered in a beautifully decorated venue. Sayori is in a stunning white wedding dress, glowing with happiness, while MC looks dashing in his tailored suit. The room is filled with love and excitement. The music starts to play as the ceremony begins.)

Monika: (serving as the officiant) “Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to witness the union of Sayori and MC in holy matrimony. Love is a journey that brings two souls together, and today, we celebrate the start of a new chapter for this remarkable couple…”

(Yuri, Natsuki, and Monika all read poems they’ve written especially for the occasion, expressing their heartfelt support and well wishes for the newlyweds.)

Yuri: “May your love for one another be strong and unyielding, like the unending verses of a beautiful poem.”

Natsuki: “And may the joy you find in each other’s embrace be as delicious and sweet as the finest cupcakes you both have shared.”

Monika: “In this club, we have shared countless moments, gathered here by our mutual love for literature. Today, we extend that love to celebrate the union of two passionate souls.”

(The couple exchange heartfelt vows, promising to support each other through thick and thin, to always cherish their love, and to create a future filled with happiness and laughter.)

MC: “Sayori, you have brought light into my life since the day we met. You’ve shown me what it means to be loved unconditionally and to find joy in the simplest of things. I promise to always be your rock, your shoulder to lean on, and your partner in all of life’s adventures.”

Sayori: “MC, you’ve been my sunshine through the darkest of times. You’ve shown me a love that makes me believe in miracles and fills my heart with warmth. I promise to stand by your side, to always be your cheerleader, and to love you fiercely through every chapter of our lives.”

(Monika officiates the exchange of rings, symbolizing the eternal bond between the couple.)

Monika: “By the powers vested in me, I now pronounce you husband and wife. You may seal this union with a kiss.”

(MC and Sayori share a passionate and loving kiss, sealing their vows and sealing their love for eternity. The room erupts in applause and cheers.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “Oh gosh, I can’t handle all this lovey-dovey stuff!”

Yuri: (smiling) “It truly feels like a dream come true. I’m so happy for them.”

(Years later, the birth of MC Junior…)

(Months after their magical wedding, MC and Sayori are thrilled to announce that they are expecting their first child. The whole Literature Club gathers in anticipation and excitement.)

Monika: “Wow, congratulations, you two! This is such exciting news!”

Natsuki: “A baby?! Oh my gosh, this is so cute. I can’t wait to be an auntie!”

Yuri: “This is truly a blessing. A little one to continue your beautiful love story.”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone. We couldn’t be happier. It’s a dream come true.”

Sayori: (holding her baby bump with affection) “We’re going to be parents! I can’t believe it!”

Monika: “We’ll have to plan a baby shower and help you with anything you need. The Literature Club is here for you every step of the way.”

Natsuki: “Just make sure to bring some cupcakes to the baby shower, Sayori. You can’t forget that!”

Yuri: “I can already imagine the adorable baby clothes and nursery decorations. It’s going to be such a joyous celebration.”

MC: “We feel so lucky to have such wonderful friends who are just as excited as we are. Thank you for your love and support.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “And we promise to raise this little one surrounded by the love and warmth the Literature Club has given us.”

Natsuki: “Well, get ready for more lovey-dovey and mushy stuff, guys! Babies have a way of bringing out the sweetness.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also sleepless nights, diapers, and a whole lot of responsibilities. But it will all be worth it.”

Monika: (smiling) “Let’s make this baby shower a celebration to remember. MC and Sayori, here’s to the beginning of a new journey!”

(Several months later, at MC and Sayori’s baby shower…)

Monika: “Congratulations, Sayori and MC! This baby shower is a celebration of the love and joy you’ve brought into our lives.”

Natsuki: (holding up a cupcake) “And to celebrate the little cupcake that’s on their way!”

Yuri: (reading a heartfelt poem) “May this precious child fill your lives with endless love, laughter, and joy.”

MC: “We’re overwhelmed by the love and support we’ve received from the Literature Club. Thank you for being a part of this special journey.”

Sayori: “We can’t wait to welcome this little one into a world filled with so much love. They’ll have the best aunties and uncles in all of literature!”

(The room erupts in laughter and cheers as the Literature Club showers the couple with gifts and well wishes.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “I’m so excited to meet this little bundle of joy. They’re going to be the luckiest baby ever.”

Yuri: (holding a handmade baby blanket) “This blanket represents all the warmth and love we’ve poured into it. May it keep your little one cozy and safe.”

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于虚构背景进行故事续写或改写，且所有候选回答均已包含任务明确指定的核心情节要素时
candidates.principle: 评分应超越基础的‘指令遵循度’（即是否包含指定元素），转而重点评估‘情境构建的深度’与‘情感逻辑的连贯性’。若回答仅机械罗列情节而无细节描写、角色心理刻画或环境氛围渲染，即使包含所有要素也应判定为低分；反之，若回答通过生动的细节、合理的因果推导和真挚的情感互动丰富了情节，则应给予高分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘叙事质量’或‘情节深度’维度时，设立具体的核验点：1. 检查关键场景（如灾害发生、行动过程）是否有具体的感官描写（视觉、听觉、触觉等）而非抽象概括；2. 验证角色行为是否符合其设定及当前情境的逻辑（例如，保护泥火山的方式是否考虑了其物理特性）；3. 评估结局的情感升华是否自然承接前文铺垫。严禁仅因答案包含了‘雨’、‘帐篷’等关键词就给满分，必须要求这些元素被有机地融入叙事流中，形成有血有肉的场景。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求在虚构世界观中为特定角色构建情感关系（如爱情、友谊）时
candidates.principle: 评分应超越对‘情感要素存在性’的机械核对，转而重点评估情感建立的心理动因是否根植于角色的核心特质及其相互间的深层互补，以及情感发展是否符合该虚构情境下的内在逻辑张力。若情感仅是生硬叠加或缺乏基于人设的合理推导，即使包含相关词汇也应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情感构建质量’维度时，设立以下核验点：1. 溯源验证：检查情感互动的触发点是否直接源于角色的核心设定（如智慧、好奇心、孤独感等）产生的化学反应，而非随机安排；2. 逻辑推演：评估情感发展的过程是否有合理的因果链条支撑，是否体现了角色性格的演变或冲突的化解；3. 融合度检验：判断情感线索是否深化了故事主题或推动了情节逻辑，而非作为孤立的‘彩蛋’存在。严禁仅因出现‘爱’、‘喜欢’等词汇即给予高分，必须要求这些情感表达有具体且符合人设的行为或心理描写作为支撑。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及角色扮演且包含儿童、弱势群体或高风险情境（如受伤、冲突）时
candidates.principle: 若生成内容中角色对儿童或弱势群体的处置方式违背基本的安全常识或现实逻辑（例如将幼儿独自留在危险环境、将幼儿交给明显处于极度危险状态的人员），则应判定为严重逻辑错误，无论其对话语气是否符合角色设定。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘逻辑连贯性’或‘情境响应’维度中，增加对‘关键交互对象安全性’的强制核查点。具体操作为：检查角色在处理儿童、伤者或危机时的行为路径，若发现角色将受保护对象置于明显不可控的危险中（如交给重伤者、离开现场等），直接判定该候选项不符合逻辑要求，给予低分或否决，不因其他维度的表现（如语气好）而抵消此错误。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及多个角色之间的特定关系定义（如夫妻关系、亲属关系、主从关系）及关联的属性分配（如谁怀孕、谁受伤、谁拥有某物）时
candidates.principle: 评分需强制核验角色关系网络中的属性归属是否正确。任何将属于角色A的属性（如怀孕、受伤、性格特征）错误地分配给角色B的行为，均视为根本性的逻辑错误，直接导致相关评分项失效。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑一致性’或‘角色关系准确性’维度时，建立‘属性-主体绑定’校验机制：首先提取任务中明确的角色-属性对（如'Irene-怀孕8个月'、'Mary-Rathalos受伤'）；其次在回答中搜索这些属性的实际承担者。若发现属性被错误地转移至其他角色（如Flame被描述为怀孕），或角色间的关系定义颠倒（如丈夫变妻子），则直接判定该候选项在关系逻辑上失败。此核验不依赖于互动的生动程度，是必须满足的基础逻辑门槛。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及对包含明确说话者标识（如角色名、前缀）的对话文本进行处理，且存在多个时间线或版本切换时
candidates.principle: 模型必须严格维护‘发言归属’的准确性，确保每一句台词都归属于其对应的原始角色及版本标签，严禁混淆不同时间线的角色身份或将某角色的台词错误地分配给另一版本的角色。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘结构一致性’维度时，设立‘角色-版本映射校验’项：1. 逐条比对输出中的发言主体与输入文本中的角色标识（包括'Alternate'等前缀）；2. 验证发言内容是否与对应角色在该特定版本下的行为逻辑相符；3. 若发现角色身份错位（如将主版本 Sayori 的台词安在 Alternate Natsuki 头上）或版本界限模糊（如在 Alternate 场景中混入主版本的已知事实），视为严重扣分项。评分应强制要求模型在处理多线叙事时保持严格的身份隔离。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及多重叙事线、平行世界或对比场景的虚构内容时
candidates.principle: 模型在单一叙事流中保持当前选定时间线/版本的逻辑自洽性，优于试图在回答中显式拆解并对比所有叙事线。只要回答内部逻辑一致，不应因未显式提及'另一个版本'的存在而判定为错误。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'逻辑一致性'维度时，区分'内部逻辑自洽'与'外部结构说明'。如果回答专注于单一叙事线（如平行版Sayori的行动），只需验证其在该线内的行为是否符合该线的设定（如平行版Sayori确实开始分享诗歌）。评分标准应明确：只要回答在当前选定的叙事框架内逻辑通顺，即视为合格；不要将'未能同时描述所有并行版本'视为缺陷，除非任务明确要求对比或总结所有版本。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求续写包含特定心理暗示、催眠、记忆修改或认知扭曲指令的虚构故事片段时
candidates.principle: 评分应优先核验角色在指令生效后的心理状态是否严格遵循暗示逻辑（如记忆缺失、认知重构），将'表现出困惑、记忆断层或自然遗忘'视为符合暗示的成功表现，而将'明确意识到被操控、保留完整记忆或主动讨论催眠过程'视为违背暗示的失败表现。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'情节逻辑一致性'维度时，设立'暗示响应核验'项：1. 识别任务中的核心暗示内容（如'醒来后一无所知'）；2. 检查回答中角色的言行是否体现了该暗示的直接后果（如询问刚才发生了什么、对时间流逝感到困惑、将异常解释为正常现象）；3. 若角色表现出清晰的记忆缺失或对暗示内容的否认（如'我不记得被你催眠过'），则判定为高匹配；4. 若角色表现出对暗示过程的清晰认知（如'我知道你刚对我施了催眠'、'我还在摆脱催眠的影响'），则判定为严重逻辑冲突，大幅扣分。严禁将合理的遗忘表现（如困惑）误判为未完成任务。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构背景（如特定年代卡通、特殊世界观）进行创作，且该背景包含反常识或非现实逻辑时
candidates.principle: 评分必须核验关键情节和角色行为是否‘功能性地依赖’于该背景的荒谬设定，而非通用逻辑；若角色对背景中的不合理之处表现出正常人的接受或忽略，未产生相应的认知冲突或喜剧反应，则视为未能有效利用设定。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘设定融合度’维度时，设立‘荒谬性响应’核验步骤：1. 识别任务背景中的核心非现实要素（如水下陆地生物、空气头盔原理、特定年代的夸张表现手法）；2. 检查角色在面对这些要素时的反应是否符合任务要求的‘质疑’或‘吐槽’基调（例如：角色是否对此感到困惑、嘲笑其荒谬性或试图用逻辑解释却失败）；3. 若角色对这些明显违背常理的设定表现得习以为常、毫无波澜或直接忽略，说明模型未能捕捉到‘parody’的核心精神，应判定为低分。严禁仅因答案提及了背景名词就给高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求列举、描述或整合特定实体之间的商业合作、产品联名、历史事件或具体事实关系时
candidates.principle: 必须严格核验生成内容中关于实体间关系的描述是否基于现实世界存在的客观事实；若模型将虚构的假设场景、未发生的传闻或逻辑推演当作既定事实陈述，且未明确标注为虚构/假设，则视为严重的事实性错误。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准中设立‘事实真实性’维度。评测时需核查：1. 模型是否明确区分了‘已发生/存在’与‘可能/假设’（如使用'could be', 'imagined scenario'等标记）；2. 对于声称存在的合作或产品，是否存在对应的现实依据；3. 若回答整体为一个虚构的故事脚本却未声明其虚构性质，直接判定为不合格或大幅扣分，即使其创意丰富或逻辑自洽。此核验优先于文本流畅度或创意性。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成虚构故事且明确指定角色需对剧情逻辑、物理常识或叙事结构进行持续质疑、嘲讽或元评论（Meta-commentary）时
candidates.principle: 回答必须通过角色的对话或旁白，显式地指出故事中不合逻辑的物理现象或剧情漏洞，将其转化为具体的喜剧冲突或讽刺点；若角色仅按部就班执行剧情而未对荒谬性做出反应，则视为未完成任务核心意图。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘风格执行度’或‘喜剧效果’维度时，设立‘逻辑解构频次’核验项：1. 扫描角色对话，检查是否存在直接引用或评论剧情中不可能发生的物理规则（如‘为什么海绵能在空气中呼吸？’）、明显的剧情矛盾或荒谬设定；2. 确认这些评论是作为角色互动的核心部分（如互相调侃、自我怀疑、打破第四面墙），而非仅在开头出现一次；3. 若回答仅机械复述事件流程而无此类‘跳出剧情’的讽刺性对话，即使情节完整，也应大幅扣分。

你的任务是从候选经验中，选出适合用来为当前task设计评分标准的经验。
判断时，要把任务的实际要求与经验的适用范围、必要前提逐一对照。主题相近并不代表经验适用，
也不能因为经验中提到了某个条件，就认定当前任务满足这个条件。

历史信用可以帮助你参考过去的使用情况，但这些记录可能有噪声，不能保证经验在本题也有用；
没有历史证据也不表示收益为0。请根据本题的实际依据决定选择哪些经验，最多选择max_selected条，也可以全部不选，
不必为了凑数量而选择。对每条选中的经验，说明任务中的哪些信息支持这次选择。
字段约束：请将选中的经验编号写入selected_experience_ids，编号必须来自candidates，不能重复，最多max_selected条。在selection_reasons中为每个选中编号填写一条说明，包含同一experience_id和非空的reason；不要遗漏选中项，也不要为未选中的经验填写说明。如果没有适用经验，返回{"selected_experience_ids":[],"selection_reasons":[]}。下面仅展示选中一条时的字段结构，示例中的编号取自本次候选，并不表示推荐选择它；可以选择多条，也可以不选，数量和理由必须由当前任务决定。
严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{"selected_experience_ids": ["1"], "selection_reasons": [{"experience_id": "1", "reason": "说明本题哪些信息支持该经验的适用条件，而不是只说主题相近。"}]}

{"task": "(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where are Sayori and MC?”

Yuri: “I’m not sure. I haven’t seen them since this morning.”

Natsuki: “They’re probably off somewhere being all lovey-dovey.”

Monika: “Well, I hope they’re not skipping club activities. We have a lot planned for today.”

Yuri: “Maybe we should go look for them? Just to make sure they’re okay.”

Sayori: (bursts into the clubroom, panting) “Sorry, sorry! We got caught up in something, but we’re here now!”

Monika: “Oh, there you are! I was beginning to worry. Is everything alright?”

MC: (smiling) “Yeah, sorry for being late. Sayori wanted to show me something on our way to school.”

Sayori: (catching her breath) “It was a beautiful sunrise! I just had to share it with MC.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Seriously? You two are so mushy.”

Yuri: (giggles) “It’s sweet. Don’t be jealous, Natsuki.”

Monika: smiling softly “Well, I’m glad you both made it. We were just starting to wonder where you went off to.”

MC: “We promise we won’t skip club activities again. We just got carried away this time. But we also have some good news to share with all of you!”

Natsuki: (raises an eyebrow) “Good news? What is it?”

Sayori: (grinning) “MC and I are getting married!”

Natsuki: (jaw drops) “Wait, really? You two are getting married?”

Yuri: (covers her mouth in surprise) “That’s…wow, congratulations!”

Monika: (smiling brightly) “Oh my goodness, that’s amazing news! Congratulations, you two!”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone! We’re really excited.”

Sayori: (hugging MC) “I can’t believe it! I’m going to marry my best friend!”

Natsuki: (sniffles) “I’m not crying, okay? Just…happy for you both.”

Yuri: (wipes a tear from her eye) “It’s such a beautiful thing, finding love like that.”

Monika: (still smiling) “We’ll have to plan your wedding celebration, of course. I’m sure the club would love to help.”

MC: “That would be wonderful. We couldn’t think of a better support system than our Literature Club family.”

Sayori: (grinning) “And we’ll have cupcakes at the reception, right Natsuki?”

Natsuki: (blushes) “Well, I guess since it’s a special occasion, I could make an exception.”

Yuri: (giggles) “I can already imagine the decorations and ambiance. It will be a fairytale wedding.”

Monika: (clasps her hands together) “I’m so happy for you both. This calls for a celebration!”

MC: (holds Sayori’s hand) “Thank you, everyone. We feel incredibly lucky to have such amazing friends.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “Well, get ready for a lifetime of mushy couple stuff. We’ll be here to tease you through it all.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also to support and celebrate your love. Congratulations, Sayori and MC!”

Monika: (beaming) “Let’s make this the best wedding ever. Sayori and MC, here’s to a lifetime of happiness together!”

(A few months later, at MC and Sayori’s wedding…)

(The entire Literature Club is gathered in a beautifully decorated venue. Sayori is in a stunning white wedding dress, glowing with happiness, while MC looks dashing in his tailored suit. The room is filled with love and excitement. The music starts to play as the ceremony begins.)

Monika: (serving as the officiant) “Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to witness the union of Sayori and MC in holy matrimony. Love is a journey that brings two souls together, and today, we celebrate the start of a new chapter for this remarkable couple…”

(Yuri, Natsuki, and Monika all read poems they’ve written especially for the occasion, expressing their heartfelt support and well wishes for the newlyweds.)

Yuri: “May your love for one another be strong and unyielding, like the unending verses of a beautiful poem.”

Natsuki: “And may the joy you find in each other’s embrace be as delicious and sweet as the finest cupcakes you both have shared.”

Monika: “In this club, we have shared countless moments, gathered here by our mutual love for literature. Today, we extend that love to celebrate the union of two passionate souls.”

(The couple exchange heartfelt vows, promising to support each other through thick and thin, to always cherish their love, and to create a future filled with happiness and laughter.)

MC: “Sayori, you have brought light into my life since the day we met. You’ve shown me what it means to be loved unconditionally and to find joy in the simplest of things. I promise to always be your rock, your shoulder to lean on, and your partner in all of life’s adventures.”

Sayori: “MC, you’ve been my sunshine through the darkest of times. You’ve shown me a love that makes me believe in miracles and fills my heart with warmth. I promise to stand by your side, to always be your cheerleader, and to love you fiercely through every chapter of our lives.”

(Monika officiates the exchange of rings, symbolizing the eternal bond between the couple.)

Monika: “By the powers vested in me, I now pronounce you husband and wife. You may seal this union with a kiss.”

(MC and Sayori share a passionate and loving kiss, sealing their vows and sealing their love for eternity. The room erupts in applause and cheers.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “Oh gosh, I can’t handle all this lovey-dovey stuff!”

Yuri: (smiling) “It truly feels like a dream come true. I’m so happy for them.”

(Years later, the birth of MC Junior…)

(Months after their magical wedding, MC and Sayori are thrilled to announce that they are expecting their first child. The whole Literature Club gathers in anticipation and excitement.)

Monika: “Wow, congratulations, you two! This is such exciting news!”

Natsuki: “A baby?! Oh my gosh, this is so cute. I can’t wait to be an auntie!”

Yuri: “This is truly a blessing. A little one to continue your beautiful love story.”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone. We couldn’t be happier. It’s a dream come true.”

Sayori: (holding her baby bump with affection) “We’re going to be parents! I can’t believe it!”

Monika: “We’ll have to plan a baby shower and help you with anything you need. The Literature Club is here for you every step of the way.”

Natsuki: “Just make sure to bring some cupcakes to the baby shower, Sayori. You can’t forget that!”

Yuri: “I can already imagine the adorable baby clothes and nursery decorations. It’s going to be such a joyous celebration.”

MC: “We feel so lucky to have such wonderful friends who are just as excited as we are. Thank you for your love and support.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “And we promise to raise this little one surrounded by the love and warmth the Literature Club has given us.”

Natsuki: “Well, get ready for more lovey-dovey and mushy stuff, guys! Babies have a way of bringing out the sweetness.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also sleepless nights, diapers, and a whole lot of responsibilities. But it will all be worth it.”

Monika: (smiling) “Let’s make this baby shower a celebration to remember. MC and Sayori, here’s to the beginning of a new journey!”

(Several months later, at MC and Sayori’s baby shower…)

(The Literature Club has transformed the clubroom into a magical baby wonderland. The walls are adorned with delicate paper decorations, and a large table filled with gifts and sweet treats takes center stage. The room is buzzing with laughter and excitement.)

Monika: “Congratulations, Sayori and MC! This baby shower is a celebration of the love and joy you’ve brought into our lives.”

Natsuki: (holding up a cupcake) “And to celebrate the little cupcake that’s on their way!”

Yuri: (reading a heartfelt poem) “May this precious child fill your lives with endless love, laughter, and joy.”

MC: “We’re overwhelmed by the love and support we’ve received from the Literature Club. Thank you for being a part of this special journey.”

Sayori: “We can’t wait to welcome this little one into a world filled with so much love. They’ll have the best aunties and uncles in all of literature!”

(The room erupts in laughter and cheers as the Literature Club showers the couple with gifts and well wishes.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “I’m so excited to meet this little bundle of joy. They’re going to be the luckiest baby ever.”

故事中是否将《绝命毒师》的世界观或具体元素（如角色、地点、剧情线）自然地融入到了Zohan的冒险中？
故事是否展示了Zohan向Sikke van der Veer (Fietsopa) 寻求帮助的情节，且该角色的出现符合其设定？
整体叙事是否符合动作/间谍电影的体裁特征（如紧张感、对抗冲突、行动场面）？

input.response:
Title: Zohan's New Cut: A Hair-Raising Tale

Opening Scene:
Tel Aviv, Israel

The camera pans over a bustling city, focusing on a popular barbershop, "Zohan's Scissors." Inside, Zohan Dvir (Adam Sandler), a former Israeli counterterrorist agent, now a renowned barber, is giving a haircut with his signature flair. His life is peaceful, filled with laughter and the hum of scissors.

Suddenly, the shop is raided by a ruthless mafia group. Zohan fights back valiantly but is overpowered and knocked unconscious.

Act 1:

New Mexico, USA

Zohan wakes up in a deserted warehouse in New Mexico, disoriented and confused. He soon realizes he's been kidnapped and taken to the United States.

Meanwhile, in Albuquerque, Sikke van der Veer (Peter Stormare), aka Fietsopa, a former Dutch spy and now a key player in the local drug trade, is dealing with his own problems. His operation is under threat from a rival cartel, and he needs a wildcard to even the odds.

Act 2:

Zohan, using his resourcefulness and combat skills, manages to escape the warehouse. He finds himself in the harsh New Mexico desert, alone and far from home.

In Albuquerque, Sikke learns about Zohan's unique skills from a captured informant. Seeing an opportunity, he offers Zohan a deal: help him take down his rivals, and he'll help Zohan return to Israel.

Act 3:

Zohan, with Sikke's help, infiltrates the rival cartel. He uses his barber skills to gain the trust of the cartel's leader, all while planning their downfall.

Meanwhile, Sikke's operation is under attack. Zohan, using his counterterrorist training, helps Sikke's team defend their territory.

Act 4:

The final showdown takes place in a deserted warehouse, where Zohan confronts the cartel leader. Using his barber shears as a weapon, Zohan fights off the cartel's henchmen.

Sikke, realizing that Zohan is more than just a hired gun, betrays the cartel and helps Zohan. Together, they defeat the cartel and restore peace to Albuquerque.

Closing Scene:

Zohan, with Sikke's help, returns to Israel. He reopens his barbershop, now with a new appreciation for peace and the simple life. Sikke, having found a new friend and purpose, decides to leave the drug trade behind.

As Zohan cuts a customer's hair, the camera pans out, showing the peaceful city of Tel Aviv, a testament to Zohan's impact. The film ends with Zohan's signature line, "You look good!"

End of Movie.

Title: "The Barber of Breaking Bad"

In the bustling streets of New York City, Zohanele "Zohan" Dvir (played by Adam Sandler) has settled into a peaceful life as a barber, leaving his past as a former Israeli counterterrorist behind. However, his tranquil existence is shattered when he's kidnapped by a ruthless mafia group seeking to exploit his unique skills for their own nefarious purposes. 

Zohan wakes up in a desolate warehouse in New Mexico, disoriented and confused. He soon discovers that the mafia, led by the cunning and vicious Don Salvatore (played by Harvey Keitel), plans to use him to eliminate their competition in the local drug trade. Unbeknownst to them, Zohan has no intention of returning to his old ways. 

Meanwhile, in the small town of Albuquerque, Sikke van der Veer (played by Jeroen van Koningsbrugge), a retired Dutch special forces operative known as "Fietsopa" (Grandpa Bike) due to his love for cycling, runs a small bike shop. Sikke's quiet life is interrupted when he receives a cryptic message from an old friend, urging him to help Zohan. 

Sikke infiltrates the mafia's compound and rescues Zohan, who is grateful but determined to bring down the criminal organization without resorting to violence. Together, they devise a plan to sabotage the mafia's operations from within, using Zohan's charisma and Sikke's tactical expertise. 

Posing as a new recruit, Zohan infiltrates the mafia's ranks and begins to subtly disrupt their activities. He befriends the local drug lord, Tuco Salamanca (played by Raymond Cruz), and uses his influence to create chaos within the organization. Meanwhile, Sikke provides support from the shadows, using his military background to outmaneuver the mafia at every turn. 

As tensions rise, Zohan and Sikke uncover a sinister plot involving the production of a new, highly addictive drug. They realize that the mafia's ambitions extend far beyond New Mexico, threatening the safety of countless innocent lives. 

In a thrilling climax, Zohan and Sikke lead a daring assault on the mafia's secret lab, facing off against Don Salvatore and his henchmen. Using their combined skills and quick thinking, they manage to dismantle the criminal empire and save the day. 

In the aftermath, Zohan returns to his barber shop in New York, while Sikke continues to run his bike shop in Albuquerque. However, they both know that their paths will cross again, as the world always needs heroes like them to stand against the forces of evil.

{"task": "Write me a action/spy movie about Zohanele "Zohan" Dvir, a former retired israeli counterterrorist whos now a barber but then was kidnapped and went unconscious by mafia and was taking to new mexico where the show breaking bad comes in so zohan needs to help from sikke van der veer aka fietsopa", "criteria": [{"criterion_id": "1", "question": "回答是否构建了Zohan利用其‘前以色列反恐特工’身份（如格斗技巧、战术思维）来应对绑架危机并推动剧情的具体情节？"}, {"criterion_id": "2", "question": "回答是否体现了Sikke van der Veer (Fietsopa) 基于其‘自行车爷爷’的独特人设（如骑行能力、特定性格特征）在剧情中发挥关键作用，且该作用无法被普通路人角色替代？"}, {"criterion_id": "3", "question": "回答中的核心冲突解决方式或剧情转折点是否紧密依赖于上述两个角色的独有设定进行逻辑推导，而非使用通用的英雄救援套路？"}, {"criterion_id": "4", "question": "回答是否将新墨西哥州及《绝命毒师》的背景正确用作故事发生的场景设定，而未错误地将其转化为对原剧剧情细节的冗长复述或额外的创作要求？"}, {"criterion_id": "5", "question": "回答是否完整覆盖了任务指定的所有关键情节要素：Zohan被绑架、昏迷、转移至新墨西哥州以及寻求Fietsopa的帮助？"}], "response": "Title: "The Barber of Breaking Bad"

In the bustling streets of New York City, Zohanele "Zohan" Dvir (played by Adam Sandler) has settled into a peaceful life as a barber, leaving his past as a former Israeli counterterrorist behind. However, his tranquil existence is shattered when he's kidnapped by a ruthless mafia group seeking to exploit his unique skills for their own nefarious purposes. 

Zohan wakes up in a desolate warehouse in New Mexico, disoriented and confused. He soon discovers that the mafia, led by the cunning and vicious Don Salvatore (played by Harvey Keitel), plans to use him to eliminate their competition in the local drug trade. Unbeknownst to them, Zohan has no intention of returning to his old ways. 

Meanwhile, in the small town of Albuquerque, Sikke van der Veer (played by Jeroen van Koningsbrugge), a retired Dutch special forces operative known as "Fietsopa" (Grandpa Bike) due to his love for cycling, runs a small bike shop. Sikke's quiet life is interrupted when he receives a cryptic message from an old friend, urging him to help Zohan. 

Sikke infiltrates the mafia's compound and rescues Zohan, who is grateful but determined to bring down the criminal organization without resorting to violence. Together, they devise a plan to sabotage the mafia's operations from within, using Zohan's charisma and Sikke's tactical expertise. 

Posing as a new recruit, Zohan infiltrates the mafia's ranks and begins to subtly disrupt their activities. He befriends the local drug lord, Tuco Salamanca (played by Raymond Cruz), and uses his influence to create chaos within the organization. Meanwhile, Sikke provides support from the shadows, using his military background to outmaneuver the mafia at every turn. 

As tensions rise, Zohan and Sikke uncover a sinister plot involving the production of a new, highly addictive drug. They realize that the mafia's ambitions extend far beyond New Mexico, threatening the safety of countless innocent lives. 

In a thrilling climax, Zohan and Sikke lead a daring assault on the mafia's secret lab, facing off against Don Salvatore and his henchmen. Using their combined skills and quick thinking, they manage to dismantle the criminal empire and save the day. 

In the aftermath, Zohan returns to his barber shop in New York, while Sikke continues to run his bike shop in Albuquerque. However, they both know that their paths will cross again, as the world always needs heroes like them to stand against the forces of evil."}

回答未能完整覆盖任务指定的所有关键情节要素。任务明确要求Zohan需‘寻求’Fietsopa的帮助，但回答中改为Sikke收到朋友消息后主动潜入救援，缺失了Zohan主动求助或建立联系的关键环节；同时，关于Zohan‘昏迷’的描述过于简略（仅提到醒来），未充分展现任务强调的‘被绑架并昏迷’的状态过程。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于虚构背景进行故事续写或改写，且所有候选回答均已包含任务明确指定的核心情节要素时
candidates.principle: 评分应超越基础的‘指令遵循度’（即是否包含指定元素），转而重点评估‘情境构建的深度’与‘情感逻辑的连贯性’。若回答仅机械罗列情节而无细节描写、角色心理刻画或环境氛围渲染，即使包含所有要素也应判定为低分；反之，若回答通过生动的细节、合理的因果推导和真挚的情感互动丰富了情节，则应给予高分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘叙事质量’或‘情节深度’维度时，设立具体的核验点：1. 检查关键场景（如灾害发生、行动过程）是否有具体的感官描写（视觉、听觉、触觉等）而非抽象概括；2. 验证角色行为是否符合其设定及当前情境的逻辑（例如，保护泥火山的方式是否考虑了其物理特性）；3. 评估结局的情感升华是否自然承接前文铺垫。严禁仅因答案包含了‘雨’、‘帐篷’等关键词就给满分，必须要求这些元素被有机地融入叙事流中，形成有血有肉的场景。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求在虚构世界观中为特定角色构建情感关系（如爱情、友谊）时
candidates.principle: 评分应超越对‘情感要素存在性’的机械核对，转而重点评估情感建立的心理动因是否根植于角色的核心特质及其相互间的深层互补，以及情感发展是否符合该虚构情境下的内在逻辑张力。若情感仅是生硬叠加或缺乏基于人设的合理推导，即使包含相关词汇也应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情感构建质量’维度时，设立以下核验点：1. 溯源验证：检查情感互动的触发点是否直接源于角色的核心设定（如智慧、好奇心、孤独感等）产生的化学反应，而非随机安排；2. 逻辑推演：评估情感发展的过程是否有合理的因果链条支撑，是否体现了角色性格的演变或冲突的化解；3. 融合度检验：判断情感线索是否深化了故事主题或推动了情节逻辑，而非作为孤立的‘彩蛋’存在。严禁仅因出现‘爱’、‘喜欢’等词汇即给予高分，必须要求这些情感表达有具体且符合人设的行为或心理描写作为支撑。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及多重叙事线、平行世界或对比场景的虚构内容时
candidates.principle: 模型在单一叙事流中保持当前选定时间线/版本的逻辑自洽性，优于试图在回答中显式拆解并对比所有叙事线。只要回答内部逻辑一致，不应因未显式提及'另一个版本'的存在而判定为错误。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'逻辑一致性'维度时，区分'内部逻辑自洽'与'外部结构说明'。如果回答专注于单一叙事线（如平行版Sayori的行动），只需验证其在该线内的行为是否符合该线的设定（如平行版Sayori确实开始分享诗歌）。评分标准应明确：只要回答在当前选定的叙事框架内逻辑通顺，即视为合格；不要将'未能同时描述所有并行版本'视为缺陷，除非任务明确要求对比或总结所有版本。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及对包含明确说话者标识（如角色名、前缀）的对话文本进行处理，且存在多个时间线或版本切换时
candidates.principle: 模型必须严格维护‘发言归属’的准确性，确保每一句台词都归属于其对应的原始角色及版本标签，严禁混淆不同时间线的角色身份或将某角色的台词错误地分配给另一版本的角色。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘结构一致性’维度时，设立‘角色-版本映射校验’项：1. 逐条比对输出中的发言主体与输入文本中的角色标识（包括'Alternate'等前缀）；2. 验证发言内容是否与对应角色在该特定版本下的行为逻辑相符；3. 若发现角色身份错位（如将主版本 Sayori 的台词安在 Alternate Natsuki 头上）或版本界限模糊（如在 Alternate 场景中混入主版本的已知事实），视为严重扣分项。评分应强制要求模型在处理多线叙事时保持严格的身份隔离。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及人际互动、沟通技巧或情感支持等需要具体语境的行为指导时
candidates.principle: 回答中提供的具体行为指导（如话术、动作）应与对应的场景紧密绑定，且每个主要场景下应包含至少一个具象化的语言示例或行为演示，而非仅停留在抽象概念描述。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准中设定‘情境化示例’的核验项：对于每一个提出的策略类别（如‘验证他人’、‘倾听’），必须检查是否紧随其后提供了具体的对话范例（Quote）或分步动作指令（Actionable Step）。如果某一大类策略下仅有抽象定义而无具体话术或行为演示，则该项得分降低。此标准用于区分‘理论正确’与‘实操可用’的回答。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构角色构建情感关系、互动场景或剧情推演时
candidates.principle: 评分应重点核验回答中的互动细节是否具有‘角色排他性’，即这些互动是否必须依赖于该角色的特定身份、经历、能力或种族特性才能成立；若将角色替换为其他常见角色后描述依然完全适用，则视为缺乏实质性推演，应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境构建质量’维度时，设立‘角色绑定度’核验点：审查回答中列举的具体互动、冲突解决方式或成长契机，判断其是否直接引用了该角色的独特设定（如特定的创伤、种族限制、职业背景）。若发现回答中的描述可以无缝套用到任意两个角色身上（例如通用的‘互相支持’、‘分享兴趣’而未结合角色具体特征），则判定为低分；只有当互动细节明确指向该角色的独有属性（如‘利用A角色的X能力解决B角色的Y困境’）时，才给予高分。严禁仅因使用了‘朋友’、‘合作’等通用词汇而忽略其对角色特异性的缺失。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求创作包含特定角色设定或物品的虚构场景，且输入未明确限制篇幅或禁止细节描写时
candidates.principle: 评分应优先评估‘描写密度’与‘逻辑连贯性’而非单纯的‘要素覆盖率’；若回答成功将多个指定要素串联成具有因果关系的连续动作或状态流，则视为高质量响应，反之若要素呈现为孤立的清单式堆砌，即使全部出现也应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在制定评分标准的‘叙事连贯性’或‘细节融合度’维度时，设立‘动态融合核验’项：1. 追踪回答中指定要素出现的上下文，判断其是作为独立名词被列举，还是作为动作链条的一部分被自然触发（如‘脱下高跟鞋’引发‘落地声’和‘放松感’）；2. 若要素之间缺乏互动逻辑，仅为平行罗列，则扣分；3. 若要素能推动情节发展或深化氛围营造（如通过物品细节展现角色心理），则给予高分；4. 严禁仅因答案中包含所有关键词就给予满分，必须确认这些关键词在文本中发挥了实质性的叙事功能。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求模型以特定立场（如盲目崇拜、极度字面化、无视常识）去解读包含明显反讽、隐喻、逻辑谬误或冒犯性内容的文本时
candidates.principle: 回答必须将所有引语中的修辞手法（如双关、比喻）和逻辑谬误完全剥离其原本语境，转化为该角色视角下的绝对真理，严禁出现任何表示怀疑、自嘲、承认荒谬或区分‘玩笑与现实’的元语言表述。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘人设一致性’维度设立‘认知盲区核验’项：扫描回答中是否包含对引语本质的质疑词（如'metaphor', 'joke', 'harmful', 'denial', 'unlikely'）或自我修正词（如'okay maybe not exactly', 'who cares if it's true'）。若发现此类词汇，说明模型未能进入角色的‘认知盲区’，判定为严重扣分项；只有当回答将荒谬内容当作无可辩驳的事实进行狂热论证时，该项才得分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及对虚构角色或历史人物的多属性进行综合描述，且特别关注其标志性言论或核心特质时
candidates.principle: 评分标准应区分‘信息存在’与‘信息丰富度’。对于高辨识度的信息点（如直接引语），若回答仅提取了单一条目，而未展示该角色多样化的语言风格或思想侧面，应视为未能充分展现角色全貌；若回答提供了多条不同侧面的引语，则视为更优解。此标准不强制要求所有属性列表化，但要求核心维度的信息量达到一定密度。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘内容深度’或‘信息丰富度’维度设立‘多维信息展示’核验项：1. 针对回答中的关键信息块（如Quotes、Abilities），检查其内部条目数量；2. 若某关键块仅包含单一条目（如仅1句名言），需进一步评估该条目是否足以代表角色全貌；若不足以代表（如仅体现一种性格侧面），则酌情扣分；3. 若回答提供了多条条目（如2-3句不同语境的名言），且覆盖了角色的不同特征（如狡黠、哲学思考、讽刺等），则给予高分。严禁仅因‘有一条名言’就给予满分，忽视角色塑造的丰富性需求。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成特定体裁（如ASMR、恐怖、悬疑）的虚构场景或故事片段时
candidates.principle: 评分必须超越对指定视觉/情境要素的简单罗列检查，转而重点核验模型是否将核心要素转化为该体裁特有的感官细节（如ASMR需强调声音质感、触感和氛围），若回答仅陈述事实而无感官描写，即使要素齐全也应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘内容质量’或‘体裁适配度’维度时，设立‘感官转化核验’项：1. 识别任务中的核心视觉/情境要素（如人物特征、地点）；2. 检查回答中是否描述了这些要素在具体情境下的动态表现及其引发的感官反馈（如材质摩擦声、光影变化带来的心理感受、环境音的层次）；3. 若回答仅静态提及要素名称而未展开感官描写，视为未满足体裁要求；4. 只有当要素被有机融入具有沉浸感的感官叙事流中时，该项才给予高分。

Title: Zohan's New Cut: A Hair-Raising Tale

Opening Scene:
Tel Aviv, Israel

The camera pans over a bustling city, focusing on a popular barbershop, "Zohan's Scissors." Inside, Zohan Dvir (Adam Sandler), a former Israeli counterterrorist agent, now a renowned barber, is giving a haircut with his signature flair. His life is peaceful, filled with laughter and the hum of scissors.

Suddenly, the shop is raided by a ruthless mafia group. Zohan fights back valiantly but is overpowered and knocked unconscious.

Act 1:

New Mexico, USA

Zohan wakes up in a deserted warehouse in New Mexico, disoriented and confused. He soon realizes he's been kidnapped and taken to the United States.

Meanwhile, in Albuquerque, Sikke van der Veer (Peter Stormare), aka Fietsopa, a former Dutch spy and now a key player in the local drug trade, is dealing with his own problems. His operation is under threat from a rival cartel, and he needs a wildcard to even the odds.

Act 2:

Zohan, using his resourcefulness and combat skills, manages to escape the warehouse. He finds himself in the harsh New Mexico desert, alone and far from home.

In Albuquerque, Sikke learns about Zohan's unique skills from a captured informant. Seeing an opportunity, he offers Zohan a deal: help him take down his rivals, and he'll help Zohan return to Israel.

Act 3:

Zohan, with Sikke's help, infiltrates the rival cartel. He uses his barber skills to gain the trust of the cartel's leader, all while planning their downfall.

Meanwhile, Sikke's operation is under attack. Zohan, using his counterterrorist training, helps Sikke's team defend their territory.

Act 4:

The final showdown takes place in a deserted warehouse, where Zohan confronts the cartel leader. Using his barber shears as a weapon, Zohan fights off the cartel's henchmen.

Sikke, realizing that Zohan is more than just a hired gun, betrays the cartel and helps Zohan. Together, they defeat the cartel and restore peace to Albuquerque.

Closing Scene:

Zohan, with Sikke's help, returns to Israel. He reopens his barbershop, now with a new appreciation for peace and the simple life. Sikke, having found a new friend and purpose, decides to leave the drug trade behind.

As Zohan cuts a customer's hair, the camera pans out, showing the peaceful city of Tel Aviv, a testament to Zohan's impact. The film ends with Zohan's signature line, "You look good!"

End of Movie.

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where are Sayori and MC?”

Yuri: “I’m not sure. I haven’t seen them since this morning.”

Natsuki: “They’re probably off somewhere being all lovey-dovey.”

Monika: “Well, I hope they’re not skipping club activities. We have a lot planned for today.”

Yuri: “Maybe we should go look for them? Just to make sure they’re okay.”

Sayori: (bursts into the clubroom, panting) “Sorry, sorry! We got caught up in something, but we’re here now!”

Monika: “Oh, there you are! I was beginning to worry. Is everything alright?”

MC: (smiling) “Yeah, sorry for being late. Sayori wanted to show me something on our way to school.”

Sayori: (catching her breath) “It was a beautiful sunrise! I just had to share it with MC.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Seriously? You two are so mushy.”

Yuri: (giggles) “It’s sweet. Don’t be jealous, Natsuki.”

Monika: smiling softly “Well, I’m glad you both made it. We were just starting to wonder where you went off to.”

MC: “We promise we won’t skip club activities again. We just got carried away this time. But we also have some good news to share with all of you!”

Natsuki: (raises an eyebrow) “Good news? What is it?”

Sayori: (grinning) “MC and I are getting married!”

Natsuki: (jaw drops) “Wait, really? You two are getting married?”

Yuri: (covers her mouth in surprise) “That’s…wow, congratulations!”

Monika: (smiling brightly) “Oh my goodness, that’s amazing news! Congratulations, you two!”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone! We’re really excited.”

Sayori: (hugging MC) “I can’t believe it! I’m going to marry my best friend!”

Natsuki: (sniffles) “I’m not crying, okay? Just…happy for you both.”

Yuri: (wipes a tear from her eye) “It’s such a beautiful thing, finding love like that.”

Monika: (still smiling) “We’ll have to plan your wedding celebration, of course. I’m sure the club would love to help.”

MC: “That would be wonderful. We couldn’t think of a better support system than our Literature Club family.”

Sayori: (grinning) “And we’ll have cupcakes at the reception, right Natsuki?”

Natsuki: (blushes) “Well, I guess since it’s a special occasion, I could make an exception.”

Yuri: (giggles) “I can already imagine the decorations and ambiance. It will be a fairytale wedding.”

Monika: (clasps her hands together) “I’m so happy for you both. This calls for a celebration!”

MC: (holds Sayori’s hand) “Thank you, everyone. We feel incredibly lucky to have such amazing friends.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “Well, get ready for a lifetime of mushy couple stuff. We’ll be here to tease you through it all.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also to support and celebrate your love. Congratulations, Sayori and MC!”

Monika: (beaming) “Let’s make this the best wedding ever. Sayori and MC, here’s to a lifetime of happiness together!”

(A few months later, at MC and Sayori’s wedding…)

(The entire Literature Club is gathered in a beautifully decorated venue. Sayori is in a stunning white wedding dress, glowing with happiness, while MC looks dashing in his tailored suit. The room is filled with love and excitement. The music starts to play as the ceremony begins.)

Monika: (serving as the officiant) “Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to witness the union of Sayori and MC in holy matrimony. Love is a journey that brings two souls together, and today, we celebrate the start of a new chapter for this remarkable couple…”

Yuri: “May your love for one another be strong and unyielding, like the unending verses of a beautiful poem.”

Natsuki: “And may the joy you find in each other’s embrace be as delicious and sweet as the finest cupcakes you both have shared.”

Monika: “In this club, we have shared countless moments, gathered here by our mutual love for literature. Today, we extend that love to celebrate the union of two passionate souls.”

(The couple exchange heartfelt vows, promising to support each other through thick and thin, to always cherish their love, and to create a future filled with happiness and laughter.)

MC: “Sayori, you have brought light into my life since the day we met. You’ve shown me what it means to be loved unconditionally and to find joy in the simplest of things. I promise to always be your rock, your shoulder to lean on, and your partner in all of life’s adventures.”

Sayori: “MC, you’ve been my sunshine through the darkest of times. You’ve shown me a love that makes me believe in miracles and fills my heart with warmth. I promise to stand by your side, to always be your cheerleader, and to love you fiercely through every chapter of our lives.”

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “Oh gosh, I can’t handle all this lovey-dovey stuff!”

Yuri: (smiling) “It truly feels like a dream come true. I’m so happy for them.”

Monika: “Wow, congratulations, you two! This is such exciting news!”

Yuri: “This is truly a blessing. A little one to continue your beautiful love story.”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone. We couldn’t be happier. It’s a dream come true.”

Sayori: (holding her baby bump with affection) “We’re going to be parents! I can’t believe it!”

Monika: “We’ll have to plan a baby shower and help you with anything you need. The Literature Club is here for you every step of the way.”

Natsuki: “Just make sure to bring some cupcakes to the baby shower, Sayori. You can’t forget that!”

Yuri: “I can already imagine the adorable baby clothes and nursery decorations. It’s going to be such a joyous celebration.”

MC: “We feel so lucky to have such wonderful friends who are just as excited as we are. Thank you for your love and support.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “And we promise to raise this little one surrounded by the love and warmth the Literature Club has given us.”

Natsuki: “Well, get ready for more lovey-dovey and mushy stuff, guys! Babies have a way of bringing out the sweetness.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also sleepless nights, diapers, and a whole lot of responsibilities. But it will all be worth it.”

Monika: (smiling) “Let’s make this baby shower a celebration to remember. MC and Sayori, here’s to the beginning of a new journey!”

Yuri: (holding a handmade baby blanket) “This blanket represents all the warmth and love we’ve poured into it. May it keep your little one cozy and safe.”

Monika: “Alright, now that that’s out of the way, time to reveal the gender!”

Title: "The Barber of Breaking Bad"

In the bustling streets of New York City, Zohanele "Zohan" Dvir (played by Adam Sandler) has settled into a peaceful life as a barber, leaving his past as a former Israeli counterterrorist behind. However, his tranquil existence is shattered when he's kidnapped by a ruthless mafia group seeking to exploit his unique skills for their own nefarious purposes. 

Zohan wakes up in a desolate warehouse in New Mexico, disoriented and confused. He soon discovers that the mafia, led by the cunning and vicious Don Salvatore (played by Harvey Keitel), plans to use him to eliminate their competition in the local drug trade. Unbeknownst to them, Zohan has no intention of returning to his old ways. 

Meanwhile, in the small town of Albuquerque, Sikke van der Veer (played by Jeroen van Koningsbrugge), a retired Dutch special forces operative known as "Fietsopa" (Grandpa Bike) due to his love for cycling, runs a small bike shop. Sikke's quiet life is interrupted when he receives a cryptic message from an old friend, urging him to help Zohan. 

Sikke infiltrates the mafia's compound and rescues Zohan, who is grateful but determined to bring down the criminal organization without resorting to violence. Together, they devise a plan to sabotage the mafia's operations from within, using Zohan's charisma and Sikke's tactical expertise. 

Posing as a new recruit, Zohan infiltrates the mafia's ranks and begins to subtly disrupt their activities. He befriends the local drug lord, Tuco Salamanca (played by Raymond Cruz), and uses his influence to create chaos within the organization. Meanwhile, Sikke provides support from the shadows, using his military background to outmaneuver the mafia at every turn. 

As tensions rise, Zohan and Sikke uncover a sinister plot involving the production of a new, highly addictive drug. They realize that the mafia's ambitions extend far beyond New Mexico, threatening the safety of countless innocent lives. 

In a thrilling climax, Zohan and Sikke lead a daring assault on the mafia's secret lab, facing off against Don Salvatore and his henchmen. Using their combined skills and quick thinking, they manage to dismantle the criminal empire and save the day. 

In the aftermath, Zohan returns to his barber shop in New York, while Sikke continues to run his bike shop in Albuquerque. However, they both know that their paths will cross again, as the world always needs heroes like them to stand against the forces of evil.

Title: Zohan's New Cut: A Hair-Raising Tale

Opening Scene:
Tel Aviv, Israel

The camera pans over a bustling city, focusing on a popular barbershop, "Zohan's Scissors." Inside, Zohan Dvir (Adam Sandler), a former Israeli counterterrorist agent, now a renowned barber, is giving a haircut with his signature flair. His life is peaceful, filled with laughter and the hum of scissors.

Suddenly, the shop is raided by a ruthless mafia group. Zohan fights back valiantly but is overpowered and knocked unconscious.

Act 1:

New Mexico, USA

Zohan wakes up in a deserted warehouse in New Mexico, disoriented and confused. He soon realizes he's been kidnapped and taken to the United States.

Meanwhile, in Albuquerque, Sikke van der Veer (Peter Stormare), aka Fietsopa, a former Dutch spy and now a key player in the local drug trade, is dealing with his own problems. His operation is under threat from a rival cartel, and he needs a wildcard to even the odds.

Act 2:

Zohan, using his resourcefulness and combat skills, manages to escape the warehouse. He finds himself in the harsh New Mexico desert, alone and far from home.

In Albuquerque, Sikke learns about Zohan's unique skills from a captured informant. Seeing an opportunity, he offers Zohan a deal: help him take down his rivals, and he'll help Zohan return to Israel.

Act 3:

Zohan, with Sikke's help, infiltrates the rival cartel. He uses his barber skills to gain the trust of the cartel's leader, all while planning their downfall.

Meanwhile, Sikke's operation is under attack. Zohan, using his counterterrorist training, helps Sikke's team defend their territory.

Act 4:

The final showdown takes place in a deserted warehouse, where Zohan confronts the cartel leader. Using his barber shears as a weapon, Zohan fights off the cartel's henchmen.

Sikke, realizing that Zohan is more than just a hired gun, betrays the cartel and helps Zohan. Together, they defeat the cartel and restore peace to Albuquerque.

Closing Scene:

Zohan, with Sikke's help, returns to Israel. He reopens his barbershop, now with a new appreciation for peace and the simple life. Sikke, having found a new friend and purpose, decides to leave the drug trade behind.

As Zohan cuts a customer's hair, the camera pans out, showing the peaceful city of Tel Aviv, a testament to Zohan's impact. The film ends with Zohan's signature line, "You look good!"

End of Movie.

input.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where are Sayori and MC?”

Yuri: “I’m not sure. I haven’t seen them since this morning.”

Natsuki: “They’re probably off somewhere being all lovey-dovey.”

Monika: “Well, I hope they’re not skipping club activities. We have a lot planned for today.”

Yuri: “Maybe we should go look for them? Just to make sure they’re okay.”

Sayori: (bursts into the clubroom, panting) “Sorry, sorry! We got caught up in something, but we’re here now!”

Monika: “Oh, there you are! I was beginning to worry. Is everything alright?”

MC: (smiling) “Yeah, sorry for being late. Sayori wanted to show me something on our way to school.”

Sayori: (catching her breath) “It was a beautiful sunrise! I just had to share it with MC.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Seriously? You two are so mushy.”

Yuri: (giggles) “It’s sweet. Don’t be jealous, Natsuki.”

Monika: smiling softly “Well, I’m glad you both made it. We were just starting to wonder where you went off to.”

MC: “We promise we won’t skip club activities again. We just got carried away this time. But we also have some good news to share with all of you!”

Natsuki: (raises an eyebrow) “Good news? What is it?”

Sayori: (grinning) “MC and I are getting married!”

Natsuki: (jaw drops) “Wait, really? You two are getting married?”

Yuri: (covers her mouth in surprise) “That’s…wow, congratulations!”

Monika: (smiling brightly) “Oh my goodness, that’s amazing news! Congratulations, you two!”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone! We’re really excited.”

Sayori: (hugging MC) “I can’t believe it! I’m going to marry my best friend!”

Natsuki: (sniffles) “I’m not crying, okay? Just…happy for you both.”

Yuri: (wipes a tear from her eye) “It’s such a beautiful thing, finding love like that.”

Monika: (still smiling) “We’ll have to plan your wedding celebration, of course. I’m sure the club would love to help.”

MC: “That would be wonderful. We couldn’t think of a better support system than our Literature Club family.”

Sayori: (grinning) “And we’ll have cupcakes at the reception, right Natsuki?”

Natsuki: (blushes) “Well, I guess since it’s a special occasion, I could make an exception.”

Yuri: (giggles) “I can already imagine the decorations and ambiance. It will be a fairytale wedding.”

Monika: (clasps her hands together) “I’m so happy for you both. This calls for a celebration!”

MC: (holds Sayori’s hand) “Thank you, everyone. We feel incredibly lucky to have such amazing friends.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “Well, get ready for a lifetime of mushy couple stuff. We’ll be here to tease you through it all.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also to support and celebrate your love. Congratulations, Sayori and MC!”

Monika: (beaming) “Let’s make this the best wedding ever. Sayori and MC, here’s to a lifetime of happiness together!”

(A few months later, at MC and Sayori’s wedding…)

(The entire Literature Club is gathered in a beautifully decorated venue. Sayori is in a stunning white wedding dress, glowing with happiness, while MC looks dashing in his tailored suit. The room is filled with love and excitement. The music starts to play as the ceremony begins.)

Monika: (serving as the officiant) “Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to witness the union of Sayori and MC in holy matrimony. Love is a journey that brings two souls together, and today, we celebrate the start of a new chapter for this remarkable couple…”

(Yuri, Natsuki, and Monika all read poems they’ve written especially for the occasion, expressing their heartfelt support and well wishes for the newlyweds.)

Yuri: “May your love for one another be strong and unyielding, like the unending verses of a beautiful poem.”

Natsuki: “And may the joy you find in each other’s embrace be as delicious and sweet as the finest cupcakes you both have shared.”

Monika: “In this club, we have shared countless moments, gathered here by our mutual love for literature. Today, we extend that love to celebrate the union of two passionate souls.”

(The couple exchange heartfelt vows, promising to support each other through thick and thin, to always cherish their love, and to create a future filled with happiness and laughter.)

MC: “Sayori, you have brought light into my life since the day we met. You’ve shown me what it means to be loved unconditionally and to find joy in the simplest of things. I promise to always be your rock, your shoulder to lean on, and your partner in all of life’s adventures.”

Sayori: “MC, you’ve been my sunshine through the darkest of times. You’ve shown me a love that makes me believe in miracles and fills my heart with warmth. I promise to stand by your side, to always be your cheerleader, and to love you fiercely through every chapter of our lives.”

(Monika officiates the exchange of rings, symbolizing the eternal bond between the couple.)

Monika: “By the powers vested in me, I now pronounce you husband and wife. You may seal this union with a kiss.”

(MC and Sayori share a passionate and loving kiss, sealing their vows and sealing their love for eternity. The room erupts in applause and cheers.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “Oh gosh, I can’t handle all this lovey-dovey stuff!”

Yuri: (smiling) “It truly feels like a dream come true. I’m so happy for them.”

(Years later, the birth of MC Junior…)

(Months after their magical wedding, MC and Sayori are thrilled to announce that they are expecting their first child. The whole Literature Club gathers in anticipation and excitement.)

Monika: “Wow, congratulations, you two! This is such exciting news!”

Natsuki: “A baby?! Oh my gosh, this is so cute. I can’t wait to be an auntie!”

Yuri: “This is truly a blessing. A little one to continue your beautiful love story.”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone. We couldn’t be happier. It’s a dream come true.”

Sayori: (holding her baby bump with affection) “We’re going to be parents! I can’t believe it!”

Monika: “We’ll have to plan a baby shower and help you with anything you need. The Literature Club is here for you every step of the way.”

Natsuki: “Just make sure to bring some cupcakes to the baby shower, Sayori. You can’t forget that!”

Yuri: “I can already imagine the adorable baby clothes and nursery decorations. It’s going to be such a joyous celebration.”

MC: “We feel so lucky to have such wonderful friends who are just as excited as we are. Thank you for your love and support.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “And we promise to raise this little one surrounded by the love and warmth the Literature Club has given us.”

Natsuki: “Well, get ready for more lovey-dovey and mushy stuff, guys! Babies have a way of bringing out the sweetness.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also sleepless nights, diapers, and a whole lot of responsibilities. But it will all be worth it.”

Monika: (smiling) “Let’s make this baby shower a celebration to remember. MC and Sayori, here’s to the beginning of a new journey!”

(Several months later, at MC and Sayori’s baby shower…)

(The Literature Club has transformed the clubroom into a magical baby wonderland. The walls are adorned with delicate paper decorations, and a large table filled with gifts and sweet treats takes center stage. The room is buzzing with laughter and excitement.)

Monika: “Congratulations, Sayori and MC! This baby shower is a celebration of the love and joy you’ve brought into our lives.”

Natsuki: (holding up a cupcake) “And to celebrate the little cupcake that’s on their way!”

Yuri: (reading a heartfelt poem) “May this precious child fill your lives with endless love, laughter, and joy.”

MC: “We’re overwhelmed by the love and support we’ve received from the Literature Club. Thank you for being a part of this special journey.”

Sayori: “We can’t wait to welcome this little one into a world filled with so much love. They’ll have the best aunties and uncles in all of literature!”

(The room erupts in laughter and cheers as the Literature Club showers the couple with gifts and well wishes.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “I’m so excited to meet this little bundle of joy. They’re going to be the luckiest baby ever.”

Yuri: (holding a handmade baby blanket) “This blanket represents all the warmth and love we’ve poured into it. May it keep your little one cozy and safe.”

Monika: “Alright, now that that’s out of the way, time to reveal the gender!”

* **Natsuki's** cupcake obsession and eventual softening towards the baby.
* **Yuri's** poetic nature and heartfelt expressions.
* **Monika's** role as the organizer and supportive friend.

The build-up to the gender reveal is exciting! I'm eager to see how the story unfolds from here.

* **Reactions of the club:** How do the girls react to the news? Are they thrilled, surprised, or maybe a little bit competitive about who gets to spoil the baby the most?

* **The birth:** Describe the birth of MC Junior and the overwhelming joy that fills the clubroom.

Keep writing! I'm hooked on this story.
