(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where are Sayori and MC?”

Yuri: “I’m not sure. I haven’t seen them since this morning.”

Natsuki: “They’re probably off somewhere being all lovey-dovey.”

Monika: “Well, I hope they’re not skipping club activities. We have a lot planned for today.”

Yuri: “Maybe we should go look for them? Just to make sure they’re okay.”

Sayori: (bursts into the clubroom, panting) “Sorry, sorry! We got caught up in something, but we’re here now!”

Monika: “Oh, there you are! I was beginning to worry. Is everything alright?”

MC: (smiling) “Yeah, sorry for being late. Sayori wanted to show me something on our way to school.”

Sayori: (catching her breath) “It was a beautiful sunrise! I just had to share it with MC.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Seriously? You two are so mushy.”

Yuri: (giggles) “It’s sweet. Don’t be jealous, Natsuki.”

Monika: smiling softly “Well, I’m glad you both made it. We were just starting to wonder where you went off to.”

MC: “We promise we won’t skip club activities again. We just got carried away this time. But we also have some good news to share with all of you!”

Natsuki: (raises an eyebrow) “Good news? What is it?”

Sayori: (grinning) “MC and I are getting married!”

Natsuki: (jaw drops) “Wait, really? You two are getting married?”

Yuri: (covers her mouth in surprise) “That’s…wow, congratulations!”

Monika: (smiling brightly) “Oh my goodness, that’s amazing news! Congratulations, you two!”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone! We’re really excited.”

Sayori: (hugging MC) “I can’t believe it! I’m going to marry my best friend!”

Natsuki: (sniffles) “I’m not crying, okay? Just…happy for you both.”

Yuri: (wipes a tear from her eye) “It’s such a beautiful thing, finding love like that.”

Monika: (still smiling) “We’ll have to plan your wedding celebration, of course. I’m sure the club would love to help.”

MC: “That would be wonderful. We couldn’t think of a better support system than our Literature Club family.”

Sayori: (grinning) “And we’ll have cupcakes at the reception, right Natsuki?”

Natsuki: (blushes) “Well, I guess since it’s a special occasion, I could make an exception.”

Yuri: (giggles) “I can already imagine the decorations and ambiance. It will be a fairytale wedding.”

Monika: (clasps her hands together) “I’m so happy for you both. This calls for a celebration!”

MC: (holds Sayori’s hand) “Thank you, everyone. We feel incredibly lucky to have such amazing friends.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “Well, get ready for a lifetime of mushy couple stuff. We’ll be here to tease you through it all.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also to support and celebrate your love. Congratulations, Sayori and MC!”

Monika: (beaming) “Let’s make this the best wedding ever. Sayori and MC, here’s to a lifetime of happiness together!”

(A few months later, at MC and Sayori’s wedding…)

(The entire Literature Club is gathered in a beautifully decorated venue. Sayori is in a stunning white wedding dress, glowing with happiness, while MC looks dashing in his tailored suit. The room is filled with love and excitement. The music starts to play as the ceremony begins.)

Monika: (serving as the officiant) “Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to witness the union of Sayori and MC in holy matrimony. Love is a journey that brings two souls together, and today, we celebrate the start of a new chapter for this remarkable couple…”

(Yuri, Natsuki, and Monika all read poems they’ve written especially for the occasion, expressing their heartfelt support and well wishes for the newlyweds.)

Yuri: “May your love for one another be strong and unyielding, like the unending verses of a beautiful poem.”

Natsuki: “And may the joy you find in each other’s embrace be as delicious and sweet as the finest cupcakes you both have shared.”

Monika: “In this club, we have shared countless moments, gathered here by our mutual love for literature. Today, we extend that love to celebrate the union of two passionate souls.”

(The couple exchange heartfelt vows, promising to support each other through thick and thin, to always cherish their love, and to create a future filled with happiness and laughter.)

MC: “Sayori, you have brought light into my life since the day we met. You’ve shown me what it means to be loved unconditionally and to find joy in the simplest of things. I promise to always be your rock, your shoulder to lean on, and your partner in all of life’s adventures.”

Sayori: “MC, you’ve been my sunshine through the darkest of times. You’ve shown me a love that makes me believe in miracles and fills my heart with warmth. I promise to stand by your side, to always be your cheerleader, and to love you fiercely through every chapter of our lives.”

(Monika officiates the exchange of rings, symbolizing the eternal bond between the couple.)

Monika: “By the powers vested in me, I now pronounce you husband and wife. You may seal this union with a kiss.”

(MC and Sayori share a passionate and loving kiss, sealing their vows and sealing their love for eternity. The room erupts in applause and cheers.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “Oh gosh, I can’t handle all this lovey-dovey stuff!”

Yuri: (smiling) “It truly feels like a dream come true. I’m so happy for them.”

(Years later, the birth of MC Junior…)

(Months after their magical wedding, MC and Sayori are thrilled to announce that they are expecting their first child. The whole Literature Club gathers in anticipation and excitement.)

Monika: “Wow, congratulations, you two! This is such exciting news!”

Natsuki: “A baby?! Oh my gosh, this is so cute. I can’t wait to be an auntie!”

Yuri: “This is truly a blessing. A little one to continue your beautiful love story.”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone. We couldn’t be happier. It’s a dream come true.”

Sayori: (holding her baby bump with affection) “We’re going to be parents! I can’t believe it!”

Monika: “We’ll have to plan a baby shower and help you with anything you need. The Literature Club is here for you every step of the way.”

Natsuki: “Just make sure to bring some cupcakes to the baby shower, Sayori. You can’t forget that!”

Yuri: “I can already imagine the adorable baby clothes and nursery decorations. It’s going to be such a joyous celebration.”

MC: “We feel so lucky to have such wonderful friends who are just as excited as we are. Thank you for your love and support.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “And we promise to raise this little one surrounded by the love and warmth the Literature Club has given us.”

Natsuki: “Well, get ready for more lovey-dovey and mushy stuff, guys! Babies have a way of bringing out the sweetness.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also sleepless nights, diapers, and a whole lot of responsibilities. But it will all be worth it.”

Monika: (smiling) “Let’s make this baby shower a celebration to remember. MC and Sayori, here’s to the beginning of a new journey!”

(Several months later, at MC and Sayori’s baby shower…)

(The Literature Club has transformed the clubroom into a magical baby wonderland. The walls are adorned with delicate paper decorations, and a large table filled with gifts and sweet treats takes center stage. The room is buzzing with laughter and excitement.)

Monika: “Congratulations, Sayori and MC! This baby shower is a celebration of the love and joy you’ve brought into our lives.”

Natsuki: (holding up a cupcake) “And to celebrate the little cupcake that’s on their way!”

Yuri: (reading a heartfelt poem) “May this precious child fill your lives with endless love, laughter, and joy.”

MC: “We’re overwhelmed by the love and support we’ve received from the Literature Club. Thank you for being a part of this special journey.”

Sayori: “We can’t wait to welcome this little one into a world filled with so much love. They’ll have the best aunties and uncles in all of literature!”

(The room erupts in laughter and cheers as the Literature Club showers the couple with gifts and well wishes.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “I’m so excited to meet this little bundle of joy. They’re going to be the luckiest baby ever.”

Yuri: (holding a handmade baby blanket) “This blanket represents all the warmth and love we’ve poured into it. May it keep your little one cozy and safe.”

Monika: “Alright, now that that’s out of the way, time to reveal the gender!”

Keep writing! I'm hooked on this story.
